entities.summary: Micheal Patrick Olatunji Fagun was a Nigerian Roman Catholic prelate, who served as bishop of Ekiti Diocese. He was Auxiliary Bishop of old Ondo Diocese from 1971 to 1972 when Pope Paul VI created the Diocese of Ado-Ekiti from the Ondo Diocese. He retired from service on 17 April 2010.
